caption: One JSX snippet goes through Babel, becomes 3 createElement calls (div, h2, p), and React puts 3 real elements into #root, so the browser shows Dosa and 2 items. Only one JavaScript expression is evaluated: {title}, which is Dosa.

spec.title: JSX to DOM for the card snippet
spec.aria: A downward flow: the JSX snippet with title Dosa goes to Babel, which produces 3 createElement calls for div, h2 and p, which become 3 real DOM elements under #root, which the browser shows as Dosa and 2 items.
